title: 第一千六百八十八章 荒芜第一千六百八十七章 危急之时所碰到的人
slug: 荒村物语第一千六百九十四章面包
content_zh:
住进了红门里面的狗爷，这天夜里，独自去酒馆喝酒时听闻到一些事情，说是荒村出事了。本来不关心，可是转念一想，掐指一算，觉得机会来了。
于是偷偷地溜出了红门，而后往着荒村而去了。
来到荒村的时候，左右打量了一阵子，感觉一片荒凉，几乎什么也看不到，只听到东去的小河的呢喃声而已。不过这样的声音，对于此时的狗爷来说，几乎毫无意义了。
夜色苍茫。
独自徘徊在空旷之处，狗爷怆然而叹，不知为何，找寻了这么久，可是荒村到底是在何处呢？
于是长叹一声，而后打算离去，怕在这样的地方呆得久了，或许不好。因为感觉到有些不妙，可是到底什么地方出了问题，暂且还不得而知。
可是他终究还是有些不舍，毕竟是生活了那么多年的地方嘛，怎么可以说放下就放下呢？至少得去看下那老屋，不知在这样的时候，还好不好呢？
地震过后，本来一切皆化为泡影，这当然也包括自己的老屋，此时回来，终究还是毫无意义，却仍旧还是要回来看看，不然呢？
却找不到路了。
万般无奈之下，或许只好是不住地在一块干净的石头上徘徊着，而后准备睡去，因为感觉非常困顿，再不休息，这肯定不好。
恰巧那块干净的石头非常平整，独自躺在上面，显然是非常合适的。
本来不敢睡去，因为这里毕竟出过事故，死了不少人，有些人的尸体，到目前为止，尚且还没有找到，这对于有些迷信的狗爷来说，终究还是不妥，不敢随便躺在旷野，至于为何，这……
反正觉得害怕啊。
可是他已然是感到相当困顿了，眼皮子都抬不起来了，再不在那块干净的石头上略微休憩，这恐怕不好吧？
于是在那块石头上躺了下来了。
刚刚闭上了眼睛，便听闻到有什么东西在呼唤着他的名字，令人不敢听闻，极度害怕，甚至觉得不能再在这里呆下去了。
可是不成，当那个呼唤着他的名字的人出现在眼前的时候，狗爷看到，那并非是谁，而是自己的亲人。那故去多年的老人劝说着狗爷，叫他离去，不可靠近，说是不太好，有诡异的事情出现。
听闻到这样的话，狗爷不以为然，自己并非胆小之辈，纵使真的有什么不干净的东西，想必也无所畏惧。
见狗爷不听话，那故去多年的老人这便欺身上前，而后劝说着，甚至都开始不断地对着他说好话了，说是非之地不可久留，得及时离去为妙。
“可是……”狗爷沉吟着。

“快走吧，这里不是人住的地方！”那故去多年的老人悲凉地对着狗爷说道。
“这……”听闻到这样的话，狗爷真的都不知道该说些什么了。
……
正当狗爷准备再说些什么的时候，那故去多年的老人这便伸出一只手来了，而后不管这么多，直接就死死地掐住了狗爷的脖子，使之无论如何，那怕是使出了吃奶的力气，也休想挣脱掉。
使得狗爷直接就从睡梦之中惊醒过来了。
放眼看去，此地之荒凉，堪称一绝，出没其中的，无非就是一些野兽怪物之类的东西，幸好狗爷及时苏醒过来了，不然的话，后果如何，这还真不好说。
content_en:
Mr. Gou, who lived in the red door, heard something when he went to the tavern to drink alone that night, saying that something had happened in the deserted village. I didn't care at first, but then I thought about it and figured out that the opportunity had come.
So he sneaked out of the red door and headed towards the deserted village.
When I arrived at the deserted village, I looked around for a while and realized it was desolate. I could see almost nothing and could only hear the murmur of the river going east. However, such a sound is almost meaningless to Master Gou at this time.
The night is vast.
Wandering alone in an empty place, Mr. Dog sighed sadly. I don't know why I have been searching for so long, but where is the deserted village?
So he let out a long sigh, and then planned to leave, fearing that it might not be good to stay in such a place for too long. Because I feel something is not good, but what exactly went wrong is still unknown.
But after all, he was still a little reluctant to let go. After all, it was the place where he had lived for so many years. How could he just let it go? I have to at least take a look at that old house. I wonder if it’s okay at a time like this?
After the earthquake, everything was in vain, including my old house. Coming back at this time was still meaningless, but I still had to come back to see it, otherwise?
But couldn't find the way.
In desperation, I may have no choice but to linger on a clean stone, and then prepare to sleep, because I feel very sleepy, and it will definitely not be good if I don't rest.
It happened that the clean stone was very flat, and it was obviously very suitable to lie on it alone.
I didn't dare to sleep at first, because after all, there had been an accident here, and many people died, and the bodies of some people have not been found so far. This is still not appropriate for the superstitious Mr. Gou, who dare not just lie down in the wilderness. As for why, this...
Anyway, I feel scared.
But he already felt quite sleepy and couldn't even lift his eyelids. Wouldn't it be a good idea if he didn't take a rest on that clean stone?
So he lay down on that stone.
As soon as he closed his eyes, he heard something calling his name, which made him afraid to hear it, extremely frightening, and even felt that he could no longer stay here.
But it didn't work. When the person calling his name appeared in front of him, Master Gou saw that it was not who he was, but his own relative. The old man who had been dead for many years persuaded Master Gou and told him to leave and not to come near him, saying that it was not good and something strange would happen.
Hearing such words, Master Gou didn't take it seriously. He was not a timid person. Even if there was something really unclean, he would definitely not be afraid.
Seeing that Mr. Dog was disobedient, the old man who had been dead for many years came forward to persuade him, and even began to say good things to him constantly, saying that he could not stay in a place of right and wrong for a long time, and that it was better to leave in time.
"But..." Mr. Gou pondered.
"Go quickly, this is not a place for people to live!" The old man who had been dead for many years said sadly to Mr. Dog.
"This..." Hearing such words, Master Gou really didn't know what to say.
…
Just when Master Gou was about to say something more, the old man who had been dead for many years stretched out a hand, and then, no matter what, he strangled Master Gou's neck so that no matter what, even with all his strength, he could not break free.
Master Gou woke up from his sleep.
Looking at it, this place is extremely desolate. The only things that appear in it are some wild beasts and monsters. Fortunately, Master Gou woke up in time. Otherwise, it is hard to say what the consequences would be.
